en.title: 1. Setting Up Qualification Sessions
en.excerpt: Complete guide to structuring qualification rounds, setting ends and arrows per end, assigning categories to waves, and managing target lane assignments.
en.content:
1. What Are Qualification Sessions?

During the qualification stage, all archers shoot a designated number of arrows (e.g., 36 or 72 arrows) to earn ranking scores. Tournaments often split shooting into multiple sessions (such as Morning Wave for Youth divisions and Afternoon Wave for Senior Recurve and Compound) to share targets efficiently across large fields.

2. Qualification Dashboard & Session Waves

To view your tournament's qualification sessions:

  1. Navigate to your tournament in the Organizer Dashboard.
  2. Click Qualification in the left navigation sidebar (/dashboard/organizer/tournaments/[id]/qualification).
  3. Each session card displays:
    • Session Code & Lock Status: Indicates whether the session is open for changes or locked for live scoring.
    • Date & Time Window: When the shooting wave takes place.
    • Format Summary: Number of ends, arrows per end, and total arrows (e.g., 6 Ends × 6 Arrows = 36 Arrows).
    • Registered Archers: Total number of athletes assigned to shoot in this wave.

3. Configuring Scoring Formats (Ends & Arrows)

To create a new qualification session:

  1. Click the yellow + Add Session button in the top header.
  2. In the Session Info section, enter a descriptive title (e.g., Qualification Wave 1 - Morning).
  3. Under End & Arrow Format, adjust the scoring rules:
    • Number of Ends: Usually 6 ends (for 36-arrow half rounds) or 10–12 ends.
    • Arrows per End: Standard is 6 arrows for outdoor distances or 3 arrows for indoor / youth formats.
    • Total Arrows Counter: The system automatically calculates total session arrows in real time.

4. Assigning Categories to Shooting Waves

Under Tournament Category on the same setup popup, select the competition divisions that will shoot together during this session:

  • Check the boxes for all eligible categories (e.g., Recurve Men 70m and Recurve Women 70m).
  • Archeris will calculate total assigned athletes to ensure you have enough physical target bosses available.
  • Click Save to create your session.

5. Target Lane Assignments & Auto-Placement

Click on any session card or press Manage → to open the Target Assignment workspace:

  • Target Boss Layout: Athletes are placed on target faces (e.g., Target 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B) according to their category and distance.
  • Auto Placement: Click the Auto Placement button to automatically distribute archers evenly across targets by club affiliation (avoiding archers from the same club on the same target).
  • Manual Drag & Drop: Rearrange individual archers between target lanes anytime before the session is locked.
  • Print Scoresheets: Click the Print Scoresheet button in the top header to export ready-to-print official scorecards and target allocation sheets with QR codes for physical scoring backup!
